description: ICC six-page revision following the 2026-10-07 revision plan: nested prediction on experimental FGF2/ERK data with descriptive predictor names, corrected leave-one-protocol-out, phase scores, 20- and 30-min horizons, noise-adjusted skill, cell bootstrap intervals and phase-gated B3 increments; accepted execution of the authors' B3 model; calibrated waiting rules simulated on B3 with a per-history reliability constraint, oracle-gap closure, reliability-latency frontiers a feedback-delay / sampling-interval / noise condition map (calibration targets 0.90, 0.92 and 0.94) and robustness to recovery errors of the model; next-command errors split by the following pulse; natural probes in measured cells; earlier analyses (pilot, pre-registered expansion, readiness versions, robustness, sensitivity, baselines, stress, margin, kappa no-probe, AR(1) likelihood) kept for reproduction. No controller is evaluated on measured receivers; revision of 2026-10-08: stimulation-protocol trace and sample-role audit, strict reliability evaluation with disjoint roles and certified per-history calibration, one-probe calibration budgets, a prediction-to-decision link with ARX/NARX baselines, and task-definition and mismatch-form sensitivity.

verification.note: Full verify run on 2026-10-08 in the local environment listed above. The analyses of the 2026-10-08 revision (b3_window_tables, b3_waiting_strict, b3_waiting_budget, b3_predict_decide, b3_waiting_scope) were each run once after their protocols were frozen and are checked here by their verify scripts, together with the protocol and role audits; the earlier full-pipeline run of 2026-10-06 is not repeated.
